basic_info.description: ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED IN RENT! Welcome to 49 Dorado Terrace in the beautiful Mount Davidson Manor Neighborhood. This is a 3 bedroom 2 bathroom Condominium boasting over 1300 square feet of space, updated finishes, brand new appliances, new flooring and tile throughout, a fully upgraded kitchen, and a working fireplace in the living room. This unit offers 3 spacious bedrooms with two full bathrooms, a shared rooftop deck with views, garage parking, laundry, and more! All utilities are included in the monthly rent including water, garbage, building insurance, gas, and electricity! Located near Ocean Avenue, Monterey Boulevard, and West Portal amenities, this property also offers easy access to Stern Grove, Mount Davidson, Balboa Park, CCSF, and SFSU. Highly rated schools nearby include CAIS, Lick Wilmerding, Riordan, Stratford, Waldorf and more. This property is an incredible opportunity in one of San Francisco's best-kept secret neighborhoods!
